notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin token, adding {R}.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
